description:
HEEH-V1(TM) DICOM Viewer is a research and education Streamlit application for DICOM and volumetric-image viewing, calibrated measurements, quantitative analysis, experimental AI workflows, privacy-aware exports, and TCIA data access.

This software is not a certified medical device and must not be used for diagnosis, treatment planning, triage, or patient-care decisions.
title: HEEH-V1(TM) DICOM Viewer
